node.title: H3 cutoff multiplicity-layer gcd compiler
node.statement: For every prime-field dyadic row and every cutoff c<n-1, let Pcal and Qcal be the global ordered product and nonidentity quotient polynomials. If G is the gcd of Pcal and its first c Hasse derivatives, and G_j is the gcd of the first j Hasse derivatives of G, then X_c=sum_j deg gcd(Qcal,G_j^(n-1)). Replacing Qcal by gcd(Qcal,Qcal') gives exactly Y_c=sum_t(P(t)-c)_+(R(t)-1)_+. At c=18 this is a quotient-lift-free exact row compiler for X_18 and Y_18; on the official orders, the uniform product-fiber theorem truncates it to B_n=min(n-19,ceil(33n^(2/3))-19) layers, each with a divisor-plus-Bezout certificate. It supplies no upper bound or official-scale complexity claim.
